case_number: 2024 INSC 708; CRIMINAL APPEAL Nos…………………..OF 2024 (@ SLP(CRL.)NOs………………..OF 2024 @ DIARY NO. 18885 OF 2024)
summary: Fraud on court; SLP filed without petitioner's consent; vakalatnama signature forged; petitioner unaware of proceedings; proceedings initiated by son-in-law without authority; multiple advocates colluded in filing false documents; court verified signatures through testimony; proceedings dismissed as instituted by fraud.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; proceedings held as initiated by fraud on court; no maintainability due to forged vakalatnama and lack of petitioner's consent.
